name: Refund and chargeback watch
summary: Watches refund requests and card chargebacks in the business's payment platform, records each one, stages the evidence a person has written up, and queues every refund and dispute response for a person to approve. Crons read and draft; nothing refunds, submits evidence or accepts a dispute without an approval.

card-refunds-and-chargebacks.evidence: 1 of 2 discovery calls describes a refund flow with steps (the other gave no steps)

covered_by.refund-request: decision (a person or the agent records it; the refunds cron queues it)
covered_by.gather-evidence: watch (stages an evidence note the agent wrote)

crons.name: watch
crons.summary: Read disputes and recent refunds from Square, record them, and stage evidence notes that have been written up.

crons.name: refunds
crons.summary: Queue each refund a person has decided on. Never refunds on its own.

crons.name: respond
crons.summary: Queue the submit or accept a person has decided on, and flag open disputes nearing their deadline with no decision.

draft_ops_note: Draft operations are reads, plus evidence text staged on a dispute in Square. Staged evidence reaches the bank only when a submit is approved. Anything that refunds money, submits evidence to the bank or accepts a dispute is a live operation and waits for a person.

square.covers: disputes, refunds, staged text evidence, submit and accept (approval only)

gaps: Stripe: disputes, refunds and evidence are mapped, but the SDK sends write bodies as JSON and Stripe takes form-encoded bodies, so its writes are not built. No Stripe adapter until the SDK encodes forms.
Xero: a refund shows as a credit note (partial). Not built: a credit note refund needs a GST and allocation choice a person makes.
Refund requests arrive by email (Google Workspace in the calls). No intake adapter; the agent or a person records each decision in refund_decisions.
Refund and dispute capabilities are not in core/capabilities.json. Adding them is a runtime change, so it is listed here and not made in core/.
Square evidence files (photos, PDFs, signed invoices) are not built. The adapter stages text evidence only.
Square's pages do not describe logging a request, checking a case against the refund policy, or the search steps for an order. Those are judgment steps for the agent.
Payout reconciliation and matching refunds to sales are not covered by the pages read. No reconcile cron.
Square's dispute states and the refund cancellation rules come from the API spec, not a live account. Confirm both on a sandbox before any live run.
Docs-only until a Square sandbox account proves the adapter.

evidence.calls: 2 discovery calls read; 1 describes a refund flow with steps, and both name Google Workspace for inbox intake
evidence.platforms: Square help pages (refunds, disputes, dispute reports) and the Square API spec; Stripe and Xero pages read but not built (see gaps)
